messages:
ops-lucy: oncall: seeing a sudden QPS spike in eu-west, economy lane is saturating and a subset of requests are getting 502s. paging SRE. customers affected: several mid-market tenants. incident-bot: Pager created -> P0. tagging oncall.
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: P0 / regional routing anomaly / eu-west. responders: @sre-jordan @eng-ryan. runbook: smart-routing-lane-oversubscribe.
sre-jordan: ack, I'm on it. pulling top traces and LB logs now. can someone post quick impact numbers?
ops-lucy: impact snapshot: ~12 customers with errors, 2% of requests returning 5xx, p95 latency spikes to ~1.8s for affected flows (embeddings + async gen). traffic skewed to economy lane due to cached client weights.
eng-ryan: hypothesis: short-lived traffic burst + economy lane burst window failing to throttle upstream. proposal: soft-clamp economy weight and shift to regional priority/standard lanes temporarily.
eng-ryan: proposed commands:
```
# apply temporary routing change
redwoodctl routing update --region eu-west --policy smart-route \
  --weight-economy 0.05 --weight-standard 0.35 --weight-priority 0.6 \
  --burst-enabled false
```
ops-lucy: +1 to reducing economy weight. add a per-key QPS cap for economy while we observe. notify customers after stabilization.
infra-bot: API: routing policy update accepted (req_id=ix-9f7b). new weights will take effect in ~10s.
sre-jordan: applying per-key qps cap on economy lane (150 qps) to protect backends:
```
curl -s -X POST https://internal.api.redwood.ai/limits \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west","lane":"economy","per_key_qps":150}'
```
infra-bot: limits API response: 200 OK, limit applied (tx=lm-334).
sre-jordan: seeing immediate reduction in 502 rate. current 5xx ~0.3%, p95 latency down to ~620ms. continuing to monitor.
maria-pm: customer-impact note: inform top 5 affected customers that we applied routing workaround to prioritize availability; latency may be slightly higher for economy-tier tasks. drafting message.
ops-lucy: sales + success notified. drafting short status for status.redwood.ai (no public outage).
sre-jordan: plan: keep temporary weights + cap for 20 minutes, then decide on scaling vs rolling-policy change. will escalate if errors don't continue to decline.
oncall-bot: Reminder: create incident document and assign postmortem owner.
ops-lucy: postmortem owner: @maria-pm, assigned. adding notes to incident board. :thumbsup:
sre-jordan: full logs and command outputs uploaded to #incidents/artifacts. will update timeline after we confirm stable metrics.
ops-lucy: thanks everyone, keeping thread open for 20m observation window.
